parameters.content:
## Automated Disaster Alerts (Lahore)

**Every 2 min:** GDACS (earthquake/flood/cyclone/wildfire/drought) -> 300 km + Orange/Red filter -> website + Discord.
**Every 2 min:** Open-Meteo (rain/thunderstorm/wind) -> website + Discord.
**No API key needed.** Both are real data sources.

**Website URL:** open *Send to Website* and replace the URL when the real backend is ready.

**Discord:** webhook is already set in *Notify Discord*.

**Demo:** *Check Weather (Manual)* = real weather alert. *Test Alert (Manual)* = fake event enriched with real Open-Meteo values.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ username: 'Hiryali Alerts', embeds: [{ title: '🚨 ' + $json.title, description: $json.type + ' · ' + $json.country + ' · ' + $json.distanceKm + ' km from Lahore' + ($json.details ? ' · ' + ($json.details.precipitationMm ?? 0) + ' mm · ' + ($json.details.temperatureC ?? '-') + '°C' : ''), color: $json.severity === 'red' ? 15158332 : 15105570, fields: [{ name: 'Severity', value: $json.severity, inline: true }, { name: 'Source', value: $json.source, inline: true }], footer: { text: $json.test ? 'Test alert — simulated event' : 'Live alert' }, url: $json.url, timestamp: $json.detectedAt }] }) }}
